QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` passes the empty vector straight through (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`). It also returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. So a failure is indistinguishable from legitimately empty input"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper passes through the tokenizer's empty vector on failure and also returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired, so both cases give the same empty value.
